angolo: Gemini 3.8 leads by 14 points and ranks top 10
descr: Gemini 3.6 Flash (High) vs Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), see which model scores higher in Arena, how they compare by category, and how to access them for free.
intro: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) is the clear winner in the Arena comparison. It has a higher overall chat score, a better rank, and beats the 3.6 version in every tested category. The 3.6 model trails across the board and offers no advantage in the metrics provided.

sezioni.testo: The Arena chat score for Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) is 1497 while Gemini 3.6 Flash (High) scores 1483. That 14-point gap translates to about 52 % of blind voters preferring the 3.8 model. Gemini 3.8 also ranks 9th of 421 models compared with 26th for the 3.6 version. The vote count shows 62 675 votes for the 3.8 model versus 35 362 for the 3.6 model, reinforcing the lead.

Across all four Arena categories the newer model stays ahead. In coding it scores 1583 against 1538, in vision 1293 versus 1280, and in documents 1469 compared with 1454. The chat category, which determines the overall rank, also favours Gemini 3.8 with 1497 points over 1483. No category gives the 3.6 model an edge.

Both Gemini Flash variants require online access only. The estimated generation speed table lists them as "online only" for every hardware option, from RTX 3090 up to Ryzen AI Max+. Neither model can be downloaded or run on a typical home machine.

Because the size is not public and the weights are proprietary, there is no way to host them locally.

Google offers a free tier of the Gemini API for both models. The licence is proprietary and the models cannot be tried directly on FreeLLMArena. Users can sign up for the free API tier and call the models through Google’s cloud endpoint.

verdetto: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) if you want the higher Arena score, better rank, and stronger performance in chat, coding, vision and documents. Pick Gemini 3.6 Flash (High) only if you have a specific need for the older version, though the data shows no advantage.
